context.readme_summary: Requests is a simple, elegant Python HTTP library for sending HTTP/1.1 requests. One of the most downloaded Python packages (~300M downloads/week, depended upon by 4M+ repositories). Supports Python 3.10+. Key features: connection pooling, TLS/SSL verification, authentication, cookie persistence, automatic content decoding, streaming downloads, SOCKS proxy, and chunked requests. Install via 'pip install requests'.
context.folder_summary: Standard Python project structure with src/ for source code, docs/ for documentation, and config files for build (setup.py, pyproject.toml), testing (tox.ini), CI/CD (.github/), pre-commit hooks (.pre-commit-config.yaml), and documentation hosting (.readthedocs.yaml).
architecture_notes: Modern Python packaging with pyproject.toml as primary config. Source code lives in src/ directory (src-layout). Uses pre-commit for linting/formatting enforcement, tox for multi-environment testing, and ReadTheDocs for hosting documentation. Well-organized with clear separation between source, docs, and development configuration.
